text.tspan: Specific objectives · Methodological objectives
How is the intersectoral response to concurrent social and healthcare needs organized for different profiles of older people living at home?
Specific objectives
Methodological objectives
O1
Identify different profiles of older people living at home with concurrent social and
healthcare needs that may require an intersectoral response in primary care.
O1
Conduct a review of the scientific literature to identify and characterize different
profiles of older people living at home with concurrent social and healthcare needs
that may require an intersectoral response in primary care, and to determine the
needs associated with each of these profiles.
O2
Map territorial resources that may be mobilized in primary care to address the
concurrent social and healthcare needs of different profiles of older people living at
home, and characterize territorial variations in their availability, diversity,
complementarity and accessibility.
O2
Conduct a cartographic and spatial study of resources that can be mobilized in
primary care to address the different concurrent social and healthcare needs
associated with the profiles of older people living at home, in order to characterize
their distribution, availability, diversity, complementarity and territorial accessibility
across the different CLSC territories.
O3
Analyze the organizational configurations of intersectoral networks in primary care
mobilized across the territory to address the concurrent social and healthcare needs
of different profiles of older people living at home, in order to characterize how they
operate.
O3
Conduct a retrospective social network analysis (SNA) of intersectoral networks
mobilized in primary care from CLSC territories to address the concurrent social and
healthcare needs of different profiles of older people living at home, in order to
characterize their composition, the structure of their relationships, and the nature and
intensity of collaboration between actors.
Éric Bernier · 21 octobre 2026
